name: New Canaan Nature Center Summer Camp
activities: Water play and slip and slides
description_short: Outdoor nature day camp on the New Canaan Nature Center's 40 acres of ponds, fields and forest, with a new theme each week. Half day (9am to noon) for ages 3 and 4, full day (9am to 3:30pm) from the 4s and 5s through 5th grade, and an Adventure Camp for grades 6 to 8 with daily off-site trips and a Thursday cookout until 7pm.
refund_policy_summary: 75% refund for cancellations before May 15, 2026; no refunds after that. Changing or swapping weeks costs $25. Illness or family emergencies are handled case by case.

sources.note: 2026 weekly themes and pricing, preschool to grade 5
2026 Adventure Camp brochure, grades 6-8, $640 a week

warnings: This brochure covers the 2026 season, which is already over (today is 2026-10-13). Dates and prices for 2027 may be different.
Weekly price depends on the camper's group: $385 half day (ages 3-4), $545 full day (ages 4, 5, K, and 1st-2nd grade), $575 full day (3rd-5th grade). So no single price is recorded per session.
The first three weeks (June 1-18) are only for 3's, 4's, and 5's/K. Groups for 1st-2nd and 3rd-5th grade start June 22.
The 4-day weeks (June 15-18 and June 29-July 2) are called 'discounted,' but the discounted price is not given.
The camp's full name and location are not stated in the PDF. The name was taken from the website address and 'NCNC'.
